verdict.rationale: MailerSend documents an API to create, fetch, update and delete templates. It also has an email send endpoint and merge-field personalization, so the core of programmatic template management is there. The evidence does not show template versioning, and it does not explicitly show sending by template id with a variable payload. Missing for 10: template versioning via API, explicit documentation of sending by template_id with a variables payload, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create, version, and update email templates through the API and trigger sends by template id with variable payloads

citations.quote: Create, fetch, update, and delete single templates or a list of templates.
This endpoint allows you to send an asynchronous email.
Personalize content with merge fields and conditional logic.
